name: Majokko Saiban
source:
R.A. a witch, lived in a quiet forest.
One day, such a peaceful life was intimidated by an evil army.

She was captured and violated by unknown creatures and tentacles.

[From [url=https://www.dlsite.com/maniax/work/=/product_id/RJ043824.html/?locale=en_US]DLsite English[/url]]
translation:
魔女R.A.生活在一片宁静的森林里。
一天，一支邪恶的军队打破了这份安宁。

她遭到俘虏，并受到不明生物和触手的侵犯。
